title: Laurie Cunningham, in full flight.
deck: Skill, speed and courage on the wing.
body: Laurie Cunningham came to Albion from Orient and became one of the most exciting players in the late-1970s team. The club’s tribute singles out his UEFA Cup performance against Valencia as a defining display.

His brilliance existed alongside the racist abuse he and other Black players faced. The same account remembers the support he shared with Cyrille Regis and Brendon Batson. Cunningham later moved to Real Madrid; his Albion years remain central to the way the club remembers both its football and its role in challenging prejudice.
